query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

message.content:
Based on my search, here are the main places where you can buy the latest iPhone:

## Official Apple Channels

**Apple Online Store & Retail Stores**
- The most direct and reliable way to purchase the latest iPhone
- Every iPhone bought from Apple is unlocked (except some carrier financing options)
- Apple offers trade-in credit toward new iPhone 17, iPhone Air, or iPhone 17 Pro models when you trade in iPhone 13 or higher
- Specialists can help activate your new iPhone with your existing carrier and number

## Online Marketplaces & E-commerce Platforms

**China:**
- **Apple Tmall Flagship Store** - Apple's only official third-party platform direct store, supports 14-day no-reason returns
- **JD.com Self-operated Store** - Authorized Apple reseller with strong after-sales service, but only supports 7-day no-reason returns if unopened
- **Pinduoduo Billion Subsidies** - Often offers discounts of 400-500 RMB below official prices, but shipping times may be uncertain

**Pakistan:**
- **Authentico.pk** - Sells genuine PTA-approved iPhones including iPhone 17 series, with nationwide delivery

**Nepal:**
- **MobileMandu** - Authorized Apple distributor offering EMI/financing options and nationwide delivery

**Nigeria:**
- **Kara.com.ng** - Sells both brand new and certified pre-owned iPhones with manufacturer warranty

## Mobile Carriers & Telecom Providers

According to consumer surveys, **67% of US iPhone buyers prefer purchasing through mobile carriers** rather than directly from Apple, because:
- Better trade-in values
- Generous discounts when subscribing to plans
- Easier integration with existing service

Examples include:
- **2degrees** (New Zealand) - Offers iPhone 17 series with interest-free terms and plan savings
- Various local carriers worldwide offer similar bundle deals

## Wholesale/Electronics Markets

- **Calal Trading FZCO (Dubai)** - Offers wholesale pricing on latest iPhone models with worldwide shipping

## Key Considerations When Buying

| Factor | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **Warranty & Authenticity** | Official Apple channels and authorized resellers provide guaranteed genuine products with full warranty |
| **Return Policy** | Apple official: 14-day no-reason return (even if activated); Authorized resellers: typically 7-day unopened returns |
| **Pricing** | Carrier deals and promotions (like Pinduoduo subsidies) may offer lower prices than Apple direct |
| **Financing** | Many retailers offer EMI/installment plans or "Buy Now, Pay Later" options |
